body.escapeReason: the isBetaTalentId/isBetaFeature gates existed on the observed read paths (collectTalentEffects, hidden-lineage reads) but the symmetric write/resolve paths (getUpgradeableTalentIds, resolveTalentEntitlement UPGRADE, closeHiddenLineage, recordHiddenBreakthrough) were left ungated - the fix pattern gated the leak that was seen, not the full entry-point set
applicability: any scope gate applied to one member of a symmetric entry-point set (read/write/resolve/upgrade/close)
proposedProtection: when gating a record type, enumerate every public mutator/resolver that can reach it and gate the full set, not only the observed leak
